title: Who wins the Kansas Senate race in 2026

answers.quote: But I think Marshall has just enough to hang on.
answers.turn_text: Yeah, I can understand why everybody's, you know, panicking on Roger Marshall. Sounds like he did not prepare for a competitive race. And his closing ad message is, here's why I sent collection agencies after my patients as a doctor. Which is, you know, people have said when you're explaining, you're losing. But like even that explanation just doesn't. Not great. Not great. So the thing that has me not picking Roger Marshall, like picking Roger Marshall to eke this out. State of Kansas has a lot of Republicans and just not nearly as many independents and Democrats. You need the independents to split really in favor of Democrats. And you'd need Democrats to come out in massive numbers. As of this, you know, by the way, in Kansas, you can register by party. I know you can extrapolate too much from this, but as of this morning, 44% of the early vote is Republicans. 41% is registered Democrats. Again, I think Marshall hangs on. It's much closer than usual in a traditional red state. So it's kind of in that Darlene Graham in South Carolina one. Like there are a lot of states where Republicans have been used to winning for a really long time. And they got lazy and they got complacent. And I think, you know, it's going to bite them in some places this year. But I think Marshall has just enough to hang on.
answers.host_quote: And that takes us, Jim, to a shocker of a state in terms of its competitiveness this time around. A lot of us by surprise, Kansas.
